data.name: Genesis - 创世争霸
data.detailed_description:
Acesso antecipado à versão beta

This is a open beta version, please let us know your advise, thanks!


Acerca do jogo

Genesis is a controller exclusive next generation online-competitive MOBA. Utilizing Unreal 4 Engine, it boasts stunning graphics and smooth control. Genesis differentiates from classic MOBA games by opting for joystick control which is highly optimized and extremely intuitive. Set in a futuristic sci-fi world where gods and men clash to claim dominion, players can experience the joy of Genesis in its PVP or PVE game modes. The game will initially feature a rich roster of 30 heroes and a wide selection of hero, weapon and item cosmetics. Genesis is slated to be published on PC and PS4 in the spring of 2019. Players may provide feedback via communities listed below: Youtube: Rampage Games Twitter: @RampageGames_CN Facebook: Genesis_Official FB Group (Genesis Open Beta Feedback): https://www.facebook.com/groups/496976240827116/ Discord： https://discord.gg/EQPszfS Official Website： http://www.genesismoba.com

reviews.review:
First and foremost the game is currently in an open beta testing phase that will last 2 weeks with a GLOBAL release this summer. It was disclosed prior to the beta that there will only be servers located in Hong Kong (which is why everyone, myself included, has 200+ ms). Yes, playing a game with 1-2 second delay, especially a MOBA is not ideal, but if you're tired of DotA, LoL, or mobile mobas then now would be an ideal time to jump in and provide feedback to the developers as we lead up to launch.

So what the game has going for it is it's unique sci-fi setting with unique character designs, and pleasantly good looking graphics. Does this game really bring anything new to the MOBA genre? Not really. But as it stands now I feel like the game has flavor from all sorts of MOBAs, so if you're a MOBA player looking for a new home this game may have something for you. The game also offers a PvE option for players looking to break up the PvP climb, but within the same game. The PvE campaigns offer a gear progression system as well so it gives you more to do outside of just ranking up your PvP skill.

There is currently discussion on bringing keyboard and mouse support to PC with launch, so if that becomes a reality then this game could definitely become something. And in reality if it doesn't I would still probably play this game with controller exclusively. I am hopeful for the future of this game and I hope the developers will listen to community feedback to make this game great. If we see positive changes leading up to launch then I would  highly recommend checking out this game. Especially if you're tired of the current MOBAs on the market and looking for something new.

(This review was posted during OBT and is subject to change upon launch)
